_comment: Baseline of Tuas Power figures as verified 13 Oct 2026 against Tuas's own factsheets and campaign pages. The tripwire compares live values against this file. When a change is confirmed and the site is updated, update this file too — otherwise the tripwire keeps firing on the same change.

factsheet_versions._comment: Tuas encodes date and ex-GST rate in the PDF filename, e.g. powerfix_36_20261008(281)-$160_bill_rebate.pdf = 8 Oct 2026, 28.10c ex-GST. A filename change is the single most reliable repricing signal.
factsheet_versions._bootstrap: A value of "unknown" means: track this plan, but adopt whatever the first run observes and write it back here. powerdot_6 stays unknown because its filename encodes a percentage ("(10_)") rather than a decimal rate and the rate group does not match it.

rates_inc_gst_cents._comment: Tuas Power plans, GST-inclusive. Tuas RAISED rates on 6-8 Oct 2026 (36mth 29.40 -> 30.63, 24mth 29.80 -> 30.90, 12mth 31.00 -> 31.15) in the same week that SP's regulated tariff FELL 10.4% and PacificLight, Senoko and Geneco all cut. Verified 13 Oct 2026 against savewithtuas.com/our-electricity-plans/, which ties exactly to the ex-GST figures in the factsheet filenames.

campaign._comment: ONLINE: $100 on PowerFIX 24, $160 on PowerFIX 36, BILL CREDIT ONLY - no grocery e-voucher. Was due to end 11 Oct 2026; EXTENDED to 1 Nov 2026, confirmed on /promotions/ 13 Oct 2026. The 500-sign-up cap is no longer advertised on the campaign page. Other live campaigns as at 13 Oct: ONGREEN $100 on PowerFIX 25 G+, PRPL26 StarHub Premier+ worth $380, PRUOB UOB cashback up to 4.33%. A T&C PDF onrace26_tnc_20261007.pdf exists in the asset directory but no ONRACE26 campaign appears on /promotions/ yet - watch for it. CAVEAT still live: /promotions/ states the referral 'bill rebate will be revised when combined with another promotion', so the $160+$20=$180 stack is not guaranteed.

pacificlight_reference_inc_gst_cents._comment: PacificLight CUT rates on 8 Oct 2026 — Savvy Saver 36: 29.40 -> 28.90 (26.513 ex-GST), Savvy Saver 24: 29.80 -> 29.00 (26.605 ex-GST) — read from their own factsheet-detail pages on 13 Oct 2026. PacificLight is now ~1.7c CHEAPER than Tuas, reversing the Aug-Sep position. Senoko LifePower36 matches at 28.90 and Senoko LifePower24 / Geneco Get It Fixed 24 match at 29.00, so PacificLight is level with the market leaders rather than uniquely cheapest.

pacificlight_factsheet_slugs._comment: PacificLight factsheet slugs re-baselined by hand on 13 Oct 2026 from the factsheet listing. Each slug encodes plan AND factsheet date. A NEWER date on any tracked slug, or an UNTRACKED slug appearing, means PacificLight has repriced. NOTE: check.py currently only RECORDS these in rates-watch.json's pacificlight_discovery block and does NOT raise CHANGED on them — the 8 Oct reprice was captured on 11 Oct but reported as UNCHANGED. Widening check.py to diff these against this baseline is the single highest-value fix to the tripwire.

sp_regulated_tariff._comment: SP Group regulated tariff for Q4 2026 (1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026): 28.59c ex-GST = 31.16c inc-GST, down 10.4% from 34.78c inc-GST in Q3. Both site pages now quote 31.16c. Confirm against spgroup.com.sg at each quarter boundary; next revision due 1 Jan 2027.

editorial_position._comment: INVERTED on 13 Oct 2026. The Aug-Sep position (rates converged, nobody cheapest, rebates and perks decide) is dead. PacificLight is now ~1.73c cheaper than Tuas on 36 months and ~1.90c on 24 — worth roughly $242 over a three-year contract at 388.5 kWh/month, more than Tuas's $160 rebate returns. The site now says plainly that PacificLight is the cheaper choice and that Tuas's remaining advantage is the 12 months of free Singlife insurance. Neither page claims any retailer is 'cheapest in Singapore': PacificLight ties Senoko on both terms and Geneco on 24 months, and Keppel and Sembcorp publish no residential rate.
